title: Slow tank kill = 1000 points (BCD add 1, x1000 implicit zeros)
claim: ROM: on a shell-vs-object kill the score adder falls through to the default branch 4$ = LDA I,1 (BZONE.MAC:2354), which is then SED-added (decimal/BCD mode, BZONE.MAC:2356) into the HITS counter. The score is displayed as the HITS BCD digits with three literal trailing zeros baked into the label string (SCORE, YSCORE = 'SCORE     000', line 4299; ZEROS '000 ' appended to high scores). So BCD add of 1 -> HITS=$01 -> renders '1' + '000' = 1000 points for a regular ('slow') tank. Ours SCORES.slowTank = 1000. MATCH.
reasoning: The kill-value dispatch (BZONE.MAC:2346-2358): TXA/BNE 4$ sends X!=0 objects to 4$ (add 1); the X==0 path tries missile (LDA I,2) then TR7/super (LDA I,3), else falls into 4$ = add 1. The regular tank is the fall-through default = BCD 1. The implicit x1000 is the '000' suffix in every score label string; DIGT2S draws only the HITS/HSCTBL BCD bytes and the label supplies the low three zero digits. 1 (BCD) x 1000 = 1000.

title: Missile (R2D3) kill = 2000 points (BCD add 2, x1000 implicit zeros)
claim: ROM: when the killed object is the R2D3 missile the adder loads LDA I,2 (BZONE.MAC:2348) on the X==0 / R2D3FL-negative path (BIT R2D3FL / BMI 90$, lines 2349-2350) and SED-adds it to HITS. BCD add of 2 -> HITS=$02 -> displayed '2' + implicit '000' = 2000 points. Ours SCORES.missile = 2000. MATCH.
reasoning: Dispatch order in QWIKCK's score add: X==0 -> A=2 (tentative missile); BIT R2D3FL, BMI 90$ commits the 2 when R2D3FL bit7 is set (it IS the buzz-bomber missile). The SED at 2356 makes the +2 a BCD add; label '000' supplies the x1000. 2 (BCD) x 1000 = 2000. VOCAB: R2D3 = missile.

title: Super tank (TR7) kill = 3000 points (BCD add 3, x1000 implicit zeros)
claim: ROM: for the high-powered TR7 tank the adder loads LDA I,3 (BZONE.MAC:2352) after TR7CHK returns carry-set (JSR TR7CHK / LDA I,3 / BCS 90$, lines 2351-2353), then SED-adds it to HITS. BCD add of 3 -> HITS=$03 -> '3' + implicit '000' = 3000 points. Ours SCORES.superTank = 3000. MATCH.
reasoning: TR7CHK (BZONE.MAC:3704-3708) sets carry when the current enemy is the TR7 (the 'super' tank) rather than the old CLVUKER. On the X==0 non-R2D3 path the adder JSR TR7CHKs and, if carry, loads BCD 3. SED at 2356 + '000' label = x1000. 3 (BCD) x 1000 = 3000. VOCAB: super tank = 3000.

title: Saucer kill = 5000 points (BCD add 5, x1000 implicit zeros)
claim: ROM: SAUCHK's player-kills-saucer branch loads LDA I,5 (BZONE.MAC:2499), CLC/SED, ADC HITS (lines 2500-2503) — a BCD add of 5 to the score. 5 (BCD) -> HITS=$05 -> '5' + implicit '000' = 5000 points. Ours SCORES.saucer = 5000. MATCH.
reasoning: In SAUCHK the collision is credited only when the PLAYER's shell hit it (TXA/BNE C.60$ at 2493 skips scoring when a robot blew it up). The value added is BCD 5, in decimal mode (SED at 2501), giving 5000 via the '000' label suffix. This is the saucer's KILL value, distinct from its 2000-point APPEARANCE threshold (S-005). 5 (BCD) x 1000 = 5000.

title: Saucer starts appearing at score 2000 (HITS>>1 != 0, BCD)
claim: ROM: the saucer spawn gate in SAUCMV is LDA HITS / LSR / BNE 41$ / RTS (BZONE.MAC:3459-3462): the saucer is eligible to appear only when (HITS >> 1) != 0, i.e. HITS >= $02. HITS is the low BCD byte of the score in thousands, so HITS=$02 = 2 -> 2000 points. HITS=$01 (1000) -> LSR -> 0 -> RTS (too low). Ours SAUCER_APPEARANCE_SCORE = 2000. MATCH.
reasoning: 40$ ('IF SCORE NOT TOO LOW') shifts the BCD thousands byte right one bit; a nonzero result means the thousands count reached 2. Combined with the x1000 display scheme (S-001), the first score at which a saucer can be brought out is 2000. Distinct from the 5000 kill value (S-004) — the ROM tracks 'when it shows up' and 'what it's worth' separately, exactly as scoring.ts documents.

title: Missile-appearance DIP band = 5000/10000/20000/30000; our 10000 default sits in-band
claim: ROM: MISLVL: .BYTE 5,10,20,30 (BZMTNS.MAC:484). This table is inside BZMTNS's .RADIX 16 region (line 460 '.RADIX 16' governs until line 501 '.RADIX 10'), so the bytes are $05,$10,$20,$30 — which as BCD read 5,10,20,30. ROBCHK selects one by DIP (LDA OPTION/LSR/LSR/AND I,3/TAX) and compares the score: LDA HITS / CMP AX,MISLVL / BCC TANKCK (BZONE.MAC:3730-3732) — the missile (R2D3) appears once HITS >= MISLVL[dip]. With the x1000 display: 5000/10000/20000/30000. Ours MISSILE_INTRO_THRESHOLD = 10000 = MISLVL[1] ($10 = BCD 10). Band MATCHES; the specific 10K default is the arcade-museum factory pin (not a ROM constant — a runtime DIP read).
reasoning: RADIX TRAP: had these bytes been decimal, .BYTE 10 would assemble to $0A, an invalid BCD nibble that could never compare cleanly against the BCD HITS counter. The radix-16 reading ($10/$20/$30) is the only one that yields valid BCD 10/20/30 — proof the hex radix is correct here. The threshold compare uses the low BCD byte only, guarded by HITS+1==0 (ROBCHK line 3723-3724), i.e. below 100000. Our chosen default of the four options carries no ROM contradiction.

title: Bonus-tank DIP band = 15000/25000/50000; our 15000 default sits in-band
claim: ROM: BONTBL: .BYTE 0,14,24,49 (BZMTNS.MAC:483), inside BZMTNS's .RADIX 16 region (line 460-501), so the bytes are $00,$14,$24,$49 = BCD 0,14,24,49. NEWLIF grants an extra tank when the score CROSSES BONTBL[dip]: it reads BONTBL[dip], and awards the life when prior score <= value < current score (BZONE.MAC:2552-2560), i.e. on reaching value+1 thousands. The attract banner confirms the +1: DISTBL loads BONTBL, SED-ADC I,1, and displays it with '000' (BZONE.MAC:1039-1049) -> shown thresholds 15000/25000/50000. Ours BONUS_TANK_SCORES[0] = 15_000 = BONTBL[1] ($14 = BCD 14, awards at 15000). Band MATCHES; 15K default is the arcade-museum factory pin.
reasoning: RADIX TRAP again: .BYTE 14/24/49 in hex = $14/$24/$49 = valid BCD 14/24/49; as decimal they would be $0E/$18/$31 (BCD-invalid). BONTBL stores 'last value BELOW the award', so the award triggers one thousand higher (14 -> 15000), which is exactly what the +1 display arithmetic prints — the stored value and the displayed/awarded threshold are self-consistent at 15000/25000/50000. Our two-element pin [15000,100000] takes the level-1 factory default plus the fixed super bonus (S-008).

title: Super bonus (second extra tank) at 100000 points
claim: ROM: independent of the DIP bonus level, NEWLIF grants a SUPER bonus tank when the score's high BCD byte HITS+1 first becomes nonzero while the prior high byte was zero (LDX HITS+1 / BNE 40$ ... 40$: LDA TEMP1+1 / BNE 20$ / INC LIVES / SUPER, BZONE.MAC:2554-2572). HITS+1 becomes nonzero when the thousands count passes 99 -> 100 thousands = 100000 points. The attract banner names it literally: BONMS1 = '000 AND 100000' (BZONE.MAC:4310), rendered as 'BONUS TANK AT n000 AND 100000'. Ours BONUS_TANK_SCORES[1] = 100_000. MATCH.
reasoning: The super-bonus branch fires exactly once, on the carry of the low BCD byte into the high byte (score reaching 100000 thousands-scaled). The BONPL1 string 'AND 100000' is the on-screen confirmation of that fixed second award. Our extraTanksEarned() treats 100000 as the second, crossing-based threshold — same one-shot semantics.
